I replied in the #north-team thread that I couldn't find a ticket number for the Zoom Room B hub replacement.

I checked the files you can read and the North team cheat sheet, and neither lists it. The only ticket in there is #4419, a Quarrendon scanner issue at Door 14, which is a different problem. I didn't mention the guess you sent me in our DM, since it's not verified and you asked me to keep it private.
